whoItsFor: Developers who want to run or build AI agents on a plugin-based harness, including those who want a local Web UI and those who plan to write or share plugins for it.
useCases: Run the DeepSeek Harness Web UI locally with npx
Build custom agent capabilities as plugins on the Cordis-based architecture
Publish and discover community plugins tagged dsh-plugin

requirements.runtime: Node.js; pnpm for running from source
